fixed.summary: On the web, every file of a bundle opened at run time is fetched against the Subresource Integrity its own manifest lists (`integrity "sha384-…"`), as a package from an asset base is: bytes that differ from what was cooked fail their load once, naming the integrity, instead of loading as if intact. As there, the browser does not tell a refused hash from a network failure, so such a fetch is not tried again.
